services.name: Kinky Lake Campground
services.desc: The Pahaska Group campground is within the Cardinal River Campground. West Fraser built this campground in 2020 on the Alexis Nakota Sioux Nation’s Cardinal River Reserve to strengthen relations and to discourage random camping on their land. The campground offers beautiful views of mountains and meadows and allows ATV/OHV use. This group site has a cabin with a wood stove which is situated on the edge of a meadow along with a group firepit. There are beautiful views of Redcap Mountain. Group usage is by reservation only. 7 of the campsites have picnic table and fire-pits. There are numerous ATV trails in the area that are very popular.
